calendar.title: Calendar subscriptions
calendar.description: Put your DiveDay departures on the calendar you already use. Subscribing is read-only: DiveDay never reads or changes anything in your calendar.
calendar.refreshNote: Your calendar decides how often it re-reads the feed — usually within a few hours, not instantly. Treat DiveDay as the source of truth for a same-day change.

assignments.name: My departures
assignments.detail: Every trip you are assigned to crew, teach, or captain.

shopTrips.name: All shop departures
shopTrips.detail: Every scheduled departure at this shop, whoever is crewing it.

status.neverRead: No calendar has read it yet — paste the link into one to finish.

actions.confirmRotate: Replace this link? Any calendar still using the old one stops updating.
actions.confirmTurnOff: Turn off this subscription? The link stops working immediately.

newLink.heading: Your subscription link
newLink.shownOnce: Copy this now — for your security it is shown once. If you lose it, replace the link to get a new one.
newLink.webcalHint: Opens your calendar app and subscribes.

warning.rotate: Replacing the link stops the old one working right away. Any calendar still using it will quietly stop updating until you paste the new link in.
warning.shared: Anyone with this link can read these departures without signing in. Treat it like a password.

notice.denied: You do not have access to that calendar scope.

calendar.coverage: Covers departures from {past} days ago through {future} days ahead.

staffing.title: Staffing
staffing.description: See who is working, what each person is qualified to teach or crew, and where the next boat still has a coverage gap.

working.heading: Who is working
working.managerOnly: Shift changes require owner or manager

addShift.heading: Add a working shift
addShift.detail: A shift says when someone is available. Assign the actual crew on each trip separately.

coverage.heading: Coverage gaps
coverage.detail: These are prompts to resolve before the manifest becomes a dock-side surprise.
coverage.noTrips: No scheduled trips in this window.
coverage.allGood: Crew is assigned, and their shift covers this trip.

gap.no_shift_coverage: No working shift covers this trip

notice.overlap: That person already has an overlapping shift.
notice.staffNotFound: That staff member is no longer on this shop's team.
notice.invalid: Check the shift date and times, then try again.
notice.notAuthorized: Only owners and managers can change shifts.

certifications.heading: Certification cards
certifications.description: Evidence starts pending. Look the card number up with the issuing agency, then mark it certified — only certified cards affect readiness.
certifications.empty: No level cards yet — add their first card above so it can make them trip-ready.

card.refresherDueVerify: Refresher due — verify current status with the agency
card.tapToFlipText: Tap the card to flip and view {target}
card.flipAriaLabel: Digital certification card for {level}. Press to flip.

list.title: Courses
list.description: Your shop copy of the PADI and SSI catalog. Open a course to edit its page and pricing, or hide the ones you don't offer.

edit.description: Everything a diver reads before booking — the copy, the photos, and your pricing. The certification and minimum age come from the agency.
edit.hiddenFromDivers: Hidden from divers and the session picker.
edit.noticeShown: Course page live. Divers can read it and book a session.
edit.noticeHidden: Course page hidden. Scheduled sessions are unchanged.
edit.errorInvalid: That didn't save. Check the fields and try again.
edit.errorImages: You can keep up to eight gallery photos. Remove one before adding more.
edit.errorUpload: That photo didn't upload. Try a JPG, PNG, or WebP under 5 MB.
edit.errorTooManyPhotos: Add up to {max} new gallery photos per save. Save this batch, then add more.
edit.subheadDescription: One line under the title, e.g. “How to become a PADI Open Water Diver”.
edit.overviewDescription: A few paragraphs in the diver's words, not the agency's.
edit.pricingDescription: Two lines on one bill: your instruction fee and the agency's e-learning fee. The diver pays the total in a single payment.
edit.photosDescription: Upload your own photos. New files are added to the gallery; tick a photo to remove it.
edit.galleryPhotosHint: (up to eight in total, {max} new per save)
edit.glanceDescription: The chips across the top of the page — how the course runs. Who may take it is the next box.
edit.enrollDescription: The one block on the page that answers “can I do this?”. The certification and minimum age come from the agency: {levelAge} — shown here automatically and not editable. Your note appears under them, labelled as the shop talking, so it never reads as replacing the card the desk checks.
edit.includedPlaceholder:
6 open water dives
Full rental gear
Light lunch
edit.dayByDayDescription: One card per day: a title, real start/end times when the day runs on a fixed clock (or a free-text note when it doesn't, like "week 1–2"), and what happens.
edit.faqDescription: One block per question, separated by a blank line. First line is the question, the rest is the answer.
edit.faqPlaceholder:
Is equipment included?
Yes — mask, fins, wetsuit, BCD, regulator, and tanks.

Do I need to be a strong swimmer?
You need to be comfortable in the water.

dayByDay.timeNoteDescription: For a day with no fixed clock time, e.g. "week 1–2" or "about 3 hours". Ignored when start time is set.

pathBuilder.notOnPathDescription: Only courses that aren't already on this path are listed.
pathBuilder.allCoursesOnPath: Every course in your catalog is already on this path.

pathEdit.description: Drop courses in the order a diver would take them. Nothing here decides who may enrol — that stays with each course's own certification requirement.

pathsList.title: Certification paths
pathsList.description: The order you'd walk a diver through your courses. A path is guidance, not a gate — it never changes who may enrol in anything.
pathsList.noPathsBody: Most shops start with the one every diver asks about: Open Water, then Advanced, then Rescue.
pathsList.noCoursesYet: No courses on this path yet.
pathsList.startNewPathBody: Name it the way a diver would ask for it. You'll add the courses next.

pathsList.summaryPlaceholder: Three courses and a season of diving between them.
